hw.text: No measured hardware profile for these cards yet: memory sizes and bandwidth are catalog (datasheet) values, rates are borrowed from the nearest measured card. Every figure below is an estimate; the first boot on this hardware is the measurement.

calc: cards: 7 cards = 168.0 GiB of VRAM in total (RTX 3090 24 GB 24.0 GiB + RTX 3090 24 GB 24.0 GiB + RTX 3090 24 GB 24.0 GiB + RTX 3090 24 GB 24.0 GiB + RTX 3090 24 GB 24.0 GiB + RTX 3090 24 GB 24.0 GiB + RTX 3090 24 GB 24.0 GiB)
weights: non-expert layers 2955 + lm_head 616 + draft 4973 MiB (the 512 experts of every MoE layer stay in the host) = 8.3 GiB
KV: ONE request at the ceiling must fit the shared pool: 262144 tokens x 13056 B (fp8, 12 attention layers) = 3.2 GiB (never seats x tokens)
state: 6 seats x 56.1 MiB recurrent state (36 linear layers) = 0.3 GiB
per card outside the pool: 7 x 4784 MiB (graphs, activations, reserves; derived from the dry run) = 32.7 GiB
needed 44.6 GiB against 168.0 GiB available: margin 123.4 GiB
layout_info.name: Solo (TP only)
layout_info.satz: All cards work as one tensor-parallel group that prefills and decodes; no switching, no front.
why: 7 cards: no release boot has proven this card count on metal yet (the named blocker METAL-UNPROVEN). The numbers come from the launcher dry run; the launcher takes this layout only with force, and the first boot is the proof.
